name: cc-tuner
description: Tune Claude Code's own configuration. Ships claude-md-writer, task-flow, deep-review, a usage statusline, and a three-command spec-to-merge lifecycle: /cc-tuner:spec records DoR, tests, acceptance and DoD; /cc-tuner:plan slices the work into a committed plan and a visible task list with blocking edges; /cc-tuner:run works that plan, proves RED-to-GREEN, reviews the candidate SHA, and merges only with a verdict review and green required CI on that exact commit. Start with /cc-tuner:setup.
